t: Dine hotzaa mereshut lirshut beyom tob
s: Dine hotzaa mereshut lirshut beyom tob ubo k"b seipim: kebar bearnu besimman ttz"h demittok shehuttera hotzaa letzorek "okel nepesh" — huttera apillu shello letzorek "okel nepesh", ubilbad sheyyehe bah tzorek yom tob qetzat, apillu enah letzorek hanaat haggup ella letzorek mitzva, kegon qatan lemulo veseper tora liqrot bo. Veken im hu tzarik lelek lebet hakkeneset o letayyel lesimchat yom tob veeno yakol lehanniach et haqqatan babbayit yechidi, o shehu rotzeh leholiko immo lebet hakkeneset, o kede letayyel immo — muttar lo leholiko, sheggam hattiyyul hu tzorek simchat yom tob. Veken muttar leholik siddurim umachazorim lebet hakkeneset keshetztzarik liqrot bahem bo bayyom, ukeshem shemmuttar leholikan — kak muttar lehachaziran lebeto, ap al pi shebbachazara zo en bah tzorek yom tob kelal, shehare eno machaziran ella kede shello yigganebu veyobdu, veen zeh tzorek hayyom ella tzorek mamono — ap al pi ken hittiru lo chakamim lehachaziran, kede shello yimmana milleholikam mechamat sheyyityare shello yukal lehachaziran. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheholikan lesham beyom tob, abal im holikan lesham qodem yom tob — asur lehachaziran lebeto beyom tob, shebbishbil zeh lo yimmana milleholikan lesham qodem yom tob, shehare epshar lo lehachaziran qodem yom tob. Veen tzarik lomar sheasur lehotzi lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit dabar sheen bo tzorek yom tob kelal, kegon mapteach shel tebato shemmeotayv munnachin betokah, o shemmunnachim betokah shear debarim sheeno tzarik lo bo bayyom. Abal im munnachim betokah okalin umashqin hatztzerikim lo bo bayyom, o begadim vetakshitin hatztzerikim lo bo bayyom — muttar leholik immo hammapteach im i epshar lo lehannicho bebeto sheen sham adam neeman lo. Veken muttar leholik immo sakkin kol hayyom ap leachar shekkebar gamar seuddato, lepi shehu tzarik lo kol hayyom, sheim yizdammen lo ezeh peri yachtok bo. Abal im yadua lo shello yitztarek lesakkin bahalika zo, kegon sheholek lebet hakkeneset — asur leholiko immo.

Vekol zeh beir sheenah meorebet sheasur letaltel bah beshabbat, abal im hi meorebet beinyan shemmuttar letaltel bah beshabbat — muttar lehotzi ulehaknis apillu dabar sheen bo tzorek hayyom kelal. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehotzi ulehaknis letzorek behema o letzorek nokri, ayyen simman tqy"b.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Lehotzi ulehaknis derek rechob hair o derek mebooteha, abal lehotzi mechatzer lechatzer derek petachim vechallonot shebbenehem — en tzarik erub kelal, umuttar lehotzi kol dabar apillu sheen bo tzorek yom tob kelal mechatzer lechatzer ap al pi shello erebu yachad. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar letaltel bechatzer sheyyesh bah battim harbeh shello erebu yachad apillu dabar sheen bo tzorek yom tob kelal, raq sheyyehe muttar letaltelo beyom tob sheen alayv torat muqtzeh.

Vaapillu derek rechob hair umebooteha muttar, im hem metuqqanin belechi o qora o tzurat happetach (al derek shennitbaer besimman shs"g) ap al pi shello asu shittup meboot, shello hitzriku erube chatzerot veshittupe meboot ella beshabbat shehahotzaa asura bo legamre, abal beyom tob kevan sherob hahotzaot hen letzorek yom tob, vehen muttarot apillu birshut harabbim — lo hitzriku leareb uleshattep mishshum miut hahotzaot shehen shello letzorek hayyom kelal. Umikkol maqom, bimdinot ellu shennohagin laasot shittup echad beereb pesach lekol shabbetot hashshana — nakon haddabar liklol bo gam yom tob, velomar: "beden yehe share lana ku' lekol shabbatot veyamim tobim shel shana zo". Veken yaaseh mi shennoheg leareb erube chatzerot lekol shabbetot hashshana. Umi shennoheg leareb uleshattep lekol shabbat veshabbat bipne atzmah — yomar beshabbat shellipne yom tob: "leshabbat zo uleyom tob habbaa alenu", veen zeh niqra meshanneh et hamminhag, kevan sheeno oseh maaseh chadash.

Shappud shetztzalu bo basar, im hu eno meyuchad leshappud ella shellaqach etz chad keen shappud vetzala bo beaqray bealma — achar gemar hatztzeliyya shometo millepanayv bigrira ubetiltul min hatztzad ad shemmaabiro millepanayv leqeren zavit, kede shello yuzzequ bo. Abal asur letaltelo betiltul gamur leachar shennittal mimmennu hatztzali, lepi shennimas, umuqtzeh. Veap hammattirim muqtzeh mechamat mius beyom tob lo hittiru ella bedabar sheyyesh torat keli alayv, abal shappud zeh leachar sheggameru bo melakto — en alayv torat keli kelal, kevan sheeno meyuchad leshappud, ulepikak apillu letzorek gupo o meqomo asur letaltelo. Abal muttar lachazor velitzlot bo, dilinyan tzeliyya yesha alayv torat keli, kevan shehu chad keen shappud verauy litzliyya. Veken im tzarik limqomo lehaamid sham qedera o shear "okel nepesh" — muttar lesalleqo. Veken haddin bekol dabar shehu muqtzeh, kemo shennitbaer besop simman tq"t ayyen sham.

Sullam shel aliyya, dehaynu sullam gadol sheasuy laalot bo al gag habbayit — asur letaltelo beyom tob kemo sheasur letaltelo beshabbat, mittaam shennitbaer besimman sh"ch. Vaapillu en metaltel et kullo ella miqtzato, kegon sherotzeh lintoto meat mimmaqom lemaqom — hare zeh asur ben beshabbat ben beyom tob, kedin kol muqtzeh sheasur letaltel apillu miqtzato, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"a vesh"ch ayyen sham.
Abal muttar laalot velered alayv, veen chosheshin shemma yezizennu meat, deap im yezizennu hu dabar sheen mitkavven umuttar.

Sullam shel bayit, dehaynu sullam qatan sheeno rauy laalot bo al gag habbayit veen mishtammeshin bo ella betok habbayit — muttar letaltel mizzavit lezavit betok habbayit. Abal asur lehotzio lirshut harabbim, apillu beir hamorebet sheen bah mishshum issur hotzaa, vaapillu hu motzio letzorek simchat yom tob, kegon leholiko leshobako lehorid mimmennu gozalot — hare zeh asur mippene marit haayin, sheyyomru alayv shehu motzio lachutz kede laalot bo al haggag latuach betit (kak hayu nohagim bimehem sheggaggotehem hayu chalaqim vetuchim battit mippene haggeshamim), vahare hu oseh melaka beyom tob. Ap al pi shessullam zeh hu qatan veeno rauy laalot bo al haggag, mikkol maqom epshar sheyyismekennu lezizim hayyotzeim mehakketalim veyaaleh alehem lehaggag. Vaapillu akshav bizman hazzeh sheen lanu gaggim tuchim betit, mikkol maqom gezerat chakamim lo botla.

Abal sullam shel shobak, dehaynu shehu meyuchad laalot bo leshobak — muttar leholiko mishshobak zeh leshobak acher apillu derek reshut harabbim, veen chosheshin lemarit haayin, lepi shetztzurato mokachat alayv vehu nikkar shehu meyuchad leshobak, veyodeim hakkol shehu motzio kede leholiko leshobak, velo yachshedu oto sherotzeh laasot melaka beyom tob.
Lehotzi garap shel rei ulehachaziro — kedino beshabbat kak dino beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch.

Behema shemmeta beyom tob, im hayeta mesukkenet meereb yom tob — muttar letaltelah ulechattekah lipne hakkelabim beyom tob, lepi shemmeetmol hi omedet umukenet lakkelabim, shehu yodea shettamut beyom tob. Abal im lo hayeta mesukkenet meereb yom tob, ap al pi shehayeta chola — asur letaltelah beyom tob ledibre haoserim nolad beyom tob (kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h), shehare etmol keshehayeta adayin chayya enah mukenet lakkelabim, shello haya yodea shettamut beyom tob, vehayyom shemmeta hukena lakkelabim, vahare zeh nolad beyom tob.

Etzim shehiknisan laotzar lehatznian limot hachorep, im lo hekin otam mibbeod yom (dehaynu sheyyachshob alehem lehassaqa kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h) — asur lehassiqan beyom tob ledibre haoserim muqtzeh beyom tob. Veken aremat hatteben shello haya bedato lehistappeq mimmenna lemaakal behema ad leachar zeman merubbeh — asur lehassiq mimmenna beyom tob, ella im ken hekin otah mibbeod yom lehaoserim muqtzeh beyom tob. Veim en hatteben rauy ella lehassaqa, kegon shehu nirqab vesaruach sheeno rauy libhema, vegam yesh bo qotzim sheeno rauy legabbel bo tit lilbon lebenim mechamat haqqotzim shebbo shemmesortim yadayv veraglayv — en tzarik lehakin oto mibbeod yom, shehare hu mukan veomed lehassaqa mishshaa shennirqab venitarebu bo haqqotzim. Vaapillu im qodem leken hikniso laotzar shello lehistappeq mimmennu ad leachar zeman merubbeh, mikkol maqom, kevan shebbeshaa shehikniso laotzar haya adayin rauy libhema o letit, im ken beshaa shehikniso laotzar lo hiqtza oto ella mimmaakal behema umiggibbul tit, abal mehassaqa lo hiqtza oto kelal, shebbeet hahi lo haya yodea sheyyeraqeb veyitarebu bo qotzim velo yehe rauy ella lehassaqa, veillu haya yodea lo haya maqtzeh oto kelal.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennirqab venitarebu bo haqqotzim qodem yom tob, ap al pi shello haya yodea mizzeh ad kenisat yom tob — en bekak kelum, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y. Abal im nirqab o nitarebu bo qotzim beyom tob — en leka muqtzeh gadol mizzeh.

Vekol zeh keshehatteben hu yabesh, abal im hu lach beinyan sheeno rauy lehassiqo ella behesseq gadol shel etzim o shel teben acher — asur lehassiqo beyom tob, lepi shehesseq gadol hu dabar sheeno matzuy, umin hassetam eno omed lehesseq ella im ken hekin meereb yom tob.

Vekol zeh lehaoserin muqtzeh beyom tob, abal lehammattirin muqtzeh beyom tob — muttar lehassiq apillu meetzim shehiknisan laotzar. Veken haddin beotzar shel teben apillu lach, ap al pi shello nirqab veen bo qotzim. Ukebar nitbaer debimdinot ellu nahagu lehaqel bemuqtzeh beyom tob.

En notelim etzim min hassukka beyom tob, ben min haddepanot ben min hassekak, ap al pi sheenah sukka shel mitzva, mippene shehu kesoter binyan. Vaapillu im leachar sheggamar et kol haddepanot heemid od chabilot shel qanim etzel achat mehaddepanot kede lehaaboto ulechazzeqo al yede hosapat qanim ellu — asur littol miqqanim ellu beyom tob, lepi shehen betelin legabbe hakkotel venechshabin kemoto, kevan sheheemidan sham kede lehosip beobi haddopen — hare hen nechshabin mikkelal haddopen ap al pi shello aragan immo, vehannotel mehen hu kesoter binyan.

Abal im lo nitkavven bahen lehosip beobi haddopen ella kede lechazzeqo ulesomko bilbad, ap al pi sheheemidan sham qodem gemar arigat haddopen, kevan shello aragan im haddopen — enan betelin legabbe haddopen, veenan nechshabin kemoto, vehannotel mehem eno kesoter binyan, ella hare hen kishar kol etzim, umuttar littol beyom tob miqqanim ellu, ben shehem agudim beyachad vaasuyin kachabila, ben shehen nipradin, dekevan shello nitkavven bahen kede lehosip beobi haddopen vegam lo chibberan immo — bevadday en dato sheyyihyu omedim kan leolam, ella kesheyyitztarek lahem yittelem mikkan veyismok et haddopen bedabar acher, lepikak enan betelim legabbe haddopen.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beqanim haomedim etzel haddepanot, abal qanim hammunnachim al gabbe hassekak, ap al pi shello nitkavven bahen kede lehosip beobi hassekak ella kede lehatznian o kede leyabbeshan — asur littol mehen beyom tob, dekevan sheqqene hassekak beatzma[n] enan arugin beyachad veenan mechubbarim zeh im zeh, im ken en shum hepresh ben qene hassekak leqanim hallalu shehinniach al gabbehen vehakkol nechshab kedabar echad, vehannotel meechad mehen beyom tob — hare zeh kesoter ohel.

Abal im qanim hallalu shehinniach al gabbe hassekak hen agudin beyachad vaasuyin kachabila — muttar littol meagudda zo beyom tob, dekevan shello hittir agdan keshehinnichan al gabbe hassekak kederek kol hamsakkekin beqanim shemmattirin agdan — hare nikkar haddabar sheqqanim hallalu enan mikkelal hassekak, veenan betelim etzlo, vahare hen kishar kol etzim, kevan shello hinnichan sham kede lehosip beobi hakkotel ella kede lehatznian o kede leyabbeshan. (Vekol zeh besukka sheenah shel mitzva, abal besukka shel mitzva — yitbaer besimman trl"ch, ayyen sham).

Kol [ha]etzim sheasur littelan min hassukka, ben atze hassekak vehaddepanot atzman, ben etzim shehosip alehem beinyan sheasur littelan mehassukka beyom tob veal derek shennitbaer, apillu im nopla hassukka beyom tob — asur letaltelan, vaapillu lesorpan bimqoman asur beyom tob. Vaapillu im hassukka hayeta reua meereb yom tob veomedet lippol, mikkol maqom, kevan shebbitchillat kenisat yom tob, dehaynu beben hashshemashot, haya asur letaltelan mechamat issur setirat binyan, umittok shenneesru beben hashshemashot — neesru lekol hayyom kullo. Veap hammattirim nolad beyom tob — modim bemuqtzeh mechamat issur shennidcha bide adam beben hashshemashot, sheap beshabbat hu asur, kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h, vesukka zo nidchet beben hashshemashot bide adam shebbanu otah. Vaapillu im hitna aleha meereb yom tob sheyyihyeh muttar letaltelah likshettippol beyom tob — en tenay zeh moil kelum, deap shehaya dato aleha meereb yom tob veen bah mishshum muqtzeh, mikkol maqom yesh bah mishshum nolad, shehare etmol haya aleha shem sukka vehayyom niqret shibre etzim, ulepikak asur letaltelah lehaoserim nolad beyom tob.

Bayit satum shehu male perot mukanin shello hiknisan sham leetzor otam ad leachar zeman merubbeh ella hen omedin laakila liksheyyippachet pechat babbayit, im nipchat habbayit meelayv beyom tob, o sheppechato nokri letzorko shello letzorek yisrael — muttar leyisrael littol perot mimmeqom happechat uleoklan beyom tob, ap al pi shebbitchillat kenisat yom tob, dehaynu ben hashshemashot, lo haya dato kelal al ellu happerot, shehare lo haya epshar lo littol mehem mechamat issur setirat binyan qabua shehu chayyab min hattora — en omerim: mittok shehuqtzu beben hashshemashot huqtzu lekol hayyom, kevan sheap beben hashshemashot lo hayu muqtzim mechamat issur atzman, vegam lo hayu basis ledabar haasur mechamat atzmo, raq shehayu bemaqom shello hayu yekolin lelek lesham, ha lema zeh domeh? Leperot shehubeu michutz lattechum shehen muttarim lemi shello hubeu bishbilo, veenan asurin mishshum muqtzeh, mittaam shennitbaer.

Abal im pechato nokri letzorek yisrael — hare happerot asurim baakila ubetiltul ad haereb, vegam laereb tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, kedin nokri sheasa melaka gemura letzorek yisrael shennitbaer besimman tqt"v. Vehu haddin mi sheyyesh lo lepatot temunim bebor satum upatach nokri et habbor beyom tob letzorek yisrael (vetzarik lizzaher bezeh bime happesach keshennokri mebi lepatot limkor, im yodea shehannokri patach hayyom et habbor — asur liqqach mimmennu).
